scope: Local source audit and synthetic adversarial, sandbox and package fixtures. Real archives are hashed locally for aggregate preservation checks without displaying filenames or contents. General clipboard is not read; no outbound DaBin preview/update requests are made.

findings.fix: Skip concealed, transient, auto-generated and legacy password-manager marked actions before reading payload, including markers on later items.
Recheck source exclusions immediately before committing queued clipboard, delayed-image and screenshot saves.
Close canceled baseline-failure descriptors and reject replaced symlink folders through fresh metadata and no-follow directory descriptors.
Reject existing/dangling leaf links and enforce 0700 managed directory modes; verify originals on non-following descriptors with change detection.
Create new backup packages with 0700 modes; user-selected destinations remain under their own sync and backup settings.
Require explicit known manual receipt before optional website fetching. Unknown import origins remain preserved for recovery.
Block non-allowlisted redirects before contact, avoid cookies/credentials/cache, reject unsafe cache directory redirects.
Freeze descriptor-pinned hash-verified package bytes; preflight ZIP paths/modes/CRC and actual expansion; use exclusive commits and owned quarantine rollback.
Use exclusive atomic moves and ownership-bound rollback/cleanup to preserve competing apps.
Declare user-authorized file metadata reason 3B52.1 alongside container reason C617.1 and update local consent wording.

Locally restricted the existing owner-controlled real legacy archive root from 0755 to 0700 using a pinned non-following directory descriptor. Child content/modes were preserved; parent protection blocks other users from traversal.

assuranceLimits: Saved data and backups are not separately encrypted by DaBin; account and disk protections apply.
Clipboard markers and source-app attribution are best-effort; unmarked secrets may be captured.
Optional user-enabled manual website previews and user-initiated GitHub updates contact external services.
User-selected exports/backups can be synchronized by another service.
No claim of resistance to every hostile process sharing the same macOS user; local direct builds remain ad-hoc signed and do not add publisher pinning.
No packet-capture campaign or signed App Store runtime acceptance was performed by this audit.
Historical strict zoom performance and outstanding App Store owner/signing/acceptance gates remain open.

validation.stress: Selected production durability and flow suites pass, including restart, backup, fault injection and actual SIGKILL recovery fixtures. This is separate from historical strict zoom performance failure.

sandbox.scope: Unique ad-hoc sandbox fixture linked to exact Store module; no network or file-access grants; not final distribution-signed application acceptance.

validation.independentReview: Final read-only peer review matched all173 production inventory inputs, corrected-test attestation and receipts; no additional material flaw found in the reviewed storage/updater scope.
